description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Every HIP-3 builder-DEX perp market (xyz, flx, vntl, hyna, km, abcd, cash, para, mkts, io, and any new ones) from Hyperliquid's official public info API. Research data, not investment advice. Does not replace stock_perps (equity cut + large trades). Params dex, coin, limit. Covered by pass_day/pass_month. No charge on failure. Returns JSON for HIP-3 builder-DEX perp markets: mark, funding, open interest, and volume.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

coin.description: Optional market filter. Format: a ticker or dex:ticker. Example: TSLA. Another example already in the tool text: xyz:TSLA. Omit for every market.

dex.description: Optional builder DEX slug. Format: lowercase slug. Example: xyz. The tool text also names flx, vntl, hyna, km, abcd, cash, para, mkts, and io. Omit for every builder DEX.

limit.description: Maximum markets, ordered by 24h volume. Format: positive integer. Example: 20. Default: all markets, as the existing tool text states.

name: hl_hip3
title: HIP-3 builder-DEX perp markets ($0.005)
